findings.evidence: `Kinematics/Basic.lean:31` "Minimal process-level kinematics for inclusive DIS."; `:35-36` "Outgoing hadron momentum in exclusive/semi-inclusive projections. For inclusive DIS this field can be carried as background data."; definition `chargedLegs = Sum.elim (chargedLine K.k K.kPrime eLepton) (chargedLine K.p K.pPrime eHadron)` uses a single hadron line with equal charge in and out. The PR description itself calls this "elastic lepton-proton scattering with four charged legs".
findings.fix: State the scope explicitly: "the charged legs of elastic lepton–hadron scattering `ℓ h → ℓ h` (a single outgoing hadron carrying the incoming charge); not the inclusive final state". Apply the same change to the module-docstring bullets at lines 26 and 32.
findings.issue: `DisKinematics.chargedLegs` is described as "the charged legs of lepton–hadron scattering", but it models only the elastic (two-body) channel: one outgoing hadron with the incoming hadron's charge. `DisKinematics` is documented in `Kinematics/Basic.lean:31-36` as inclusive-DIS kinematics where `pPrime` is "background data", and inclusive DIS has a multi-leg charged final state whose eikonal current is not this one. Same wording at lines 26 and 32 of the module docstring.

findings.evidence: Grep hits: Eikonal.lean:33, :51, :53, :156, :165 all read "lepton–hadron scattering" without qualification, while the statement is over `K.chargedLegs eLepton eHadron`, which is two `chargedLine`s.
findings.fix: Qualify as "elastic lepton–hadron scattering" (single outgoing charged hadron) in all five places so a reader does not take it as the soft current for inclusive DIS.
findings.issue: `eikonalCurrent_chargedLegs` and `eikonalCurrent_chargedLegs_conserved` (line 165), and the module-docstring entries at lines 33, 51 and 53, call this "the eikonal current of lepton–hadron scattering"; it is the current of the elastic two-body channel only (see the ChargedLegs finding).

summary: Both files have accurate module docstrings and every public declaration is documented; formulas in the docstrings match the statements. One overclaim: the charged legs and their eikonal current are documented as those of generic lepton–hadron scattering, but the construction is the elastic two-body channel with a single outgoing hadron of the incoming charge, which is not the charged-leg content of inclusive DIS that `DisKinematics` is documented to model.
